description: Report all invoices, including those without line items (count 0), ranked by how many line items they have.

b.request: For each invoice, show its invoice number, the average of `derived_total_cost / derived_product_cost` across its line items, and its line-item count, including invoices with no line items as count 0; return the 10 invoices with the highest counts, ordered from most line items to fewest.
b.sql: SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(ili.derived_total_cost / NULLIF(ili.derived_product_cost, 0)) AS average_cost_ratio, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS line_item_count FROM Invoices AS i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC, i.invoice_number ASC LIMIT 10;
b.raw: For each invoice, show its invoice number, the average of `derived_total_cost / derived_product_cost` across its line items, and its line-item count, including invoices with no line items as count 0; return the 10 invoices with the highest counts, ordered from most line items to fewest.

c.request: For each invoice, show the invoice number, the average ratio of `derived_total_cost` to `derived_product_cost` across its line items, and how many line items it has. Give the 10 invoices with the most line items, from most to fewest. Report all invoices, including those without line items (count 0), ranked by how many line items they have.
c.sql: SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(1.0 * ili.derived_total_cost / NULLIF(ili.derived_product_cost, 0)) AS average_cost_ratio, COUNT(ili.invoice_number) AS line_item_count FROM Invoices AS i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC, i.invoice_number ASC LIMIT 10;

d.request: For every invoice, including those with no line items, show its invoice number, the average of `derived_total_cost / derived_product_cost` across its line items, and its line-item count; return the 10 invoices with the highest counts, ordered from most to fewest.
d.sql: SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(ili.derived_total_cost / NULLIF(ili.derived_product_cost, 0)) AS avg_cost_ratio, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS line_item_count FROM Invoices AS i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC, i.invoice_number ASC LIMIT 10

a.request: For every invoice, including those with no line items (count 0, no average), show the invoice number, the average ratio of `derived_total_cost` to `derived_product_cost` across its line items, and its number of line items. List the 10 invoices with the most line items, from most to fewest.
a.sql: SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(ili.derived_total_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(ili.derived_product_cost, 0)) AS average_ratio, COUNT(ili.invoice_number) AS line_item_count FROM Invoices AS i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC, i.invoice_number ASC LIMIT 10;
